corrections.old_text: ፯ ። ሉቃ ፳፩ ፲፪ ። ዮሐ ፲፮ ፩
corrections.corrected_text: ፯ ። ሉቃ ፳፩ ፲፪ ። ዮሐ ፲፮ ፪
corrections.reason: The cross-reference at the end of the line is John 16:2 (ዮሐ ፲፮ ፪), where ፪ was misread as ፩.
The second Johannine cross-reference is John 15:20 (፲፭ ፳ ።), misread as ፲፯ ፪ ።.
The printed Ge'ez text clearly reads 'ወያገብኡ በደመ ለሞት' (with 2nd-order ኡ and 1st-order መ in the construct state 'በደመ ለሞት').
The gloss explains the variant 'ትሴኰስ' as meaning 'ተሐፅፅ ሲል ነው' (citing the lemma ተሐፅፅ from L23-24); the initial ተ was misread as የ.
The printed glyph is 5th-order ሄ ('ሄዶ'), misread as 3rd-order ሂ ('ሂዶ').
